event.asset: Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) device for psychosis, including auditory hallucinations
event.title: FDA authorizes a TMS device for psychosis
event.proposition: The FDA grants a marketing authorization (510(k) clearance, De Novo grant or PMA approval) for a transcranial magnetic stimulation device whose indications for use name psychosis or auditory hallucinations.

records.note: 'That's gonna include psychosis' sets bin A. Psychosis is named, so E-0019 (any new TMS indication) is a different asset. 'Should use' is normative and not coded. 'Pretty soon' is not a deadline.
'We have to do a pivotal trial' is a normative next step, with no predictive reading and no named trial.
'More is coming' after a list of current TMS clearances = a new authorized TMS indication (E-0019). 'Is coming' sets bin A. 'Coming' is not a deadline.
Press-release framing. 'Value-based care' and 'increasingly critical' give no entity, event, benchmark or resolution source.
'In my practice': the forecaster sets his own treatment sequence, so he decides the outcome.
Present-tense trend in a Radial release. 'Growing payer coverage' names no payer, policy or threshold.
Reads an announced acquisition as a vote of confidence. Retrospective interpretation; no future state asserted.
'We're here to change that' is a Radial intent statement about its own programme.
What Radial will offer after its own acquisition; his own organization decides. 'Soon' gives no deadline.
'The coming of psychedelic medicines' asserts a first approval of the class (E-0024); the FDA decides. 'Is coming' sets bin A. No time words, so undated.
'What the coverage policy should be or will be' names no payer, treatment, direction or date.
A mechanism claim about payers. 'Larger coverage policies' names no payer, code or threshold.
'Payers will be pleased' is not observable, and 'One Shot' prediction is a Radial milestone with no benchmark.
Why Radial runs trials: his own organization's plan, with no named product or market event.
'We have to study it with more rigor' is normative; 'every reason to suspect' describes present evidence, with no named trial.
A six-day dosing schedule is not a named trial, and 'even quicker reductions' sets no threshold or resolution source.
Generalization to severely suicidal patients. No named trial, population threshold or resolution source.
A treatment recommendation ('the clear choice', 'a thing you choose'). Preference, not a future state.
'I will stop at nothing' is his own commitment, not a forecast about a third party.
'More large-scale data ... soon' names no study, sponsor or size threshold; 'soon' gives no deadline.
'Our subsequent data ... our one-year follow-up': his own group decides when it publishes. 'Near future' gives no deadline.
Same commitment as owen-2491 in the video source: his own effort, not a third-party outcome.
Restates the already-reported SWIFT secondary analysis (median 10 versus 13 days). Descriptive, not a forecast.
Same generalization as owen-2488. No named trial, threshold or resolution source for 'effective in more severely suicidal individuals'.
'I don't know that we're going to have that' states uncertainty with no direction and no named trial design.
Same takeaway as owen-2489 in the Q&A: a treatment recommendation, not a future state.
Same claim as owen-2492: 'more large-scale data ... soon' names no study, sponsor or size threshold.
'What I want is ...' states a wish and a route to it; no payer, policy or date is asserted.
'Faster than we are officially thinking' names no uptake metric, series or threshold, and no date.
'Psychedelics will be the first line of defense' maps to a major guideline listing a psychedelic as first line (E-0111). Strongest phrase 'will' sets bin A. 'In the future' is not a deadline.

The words name psilocybin, not COMP360, so E-0003. 'Mid next year' = middle of 2025, read as 30 June 2025. Predictive 'should be approved' sets bin B. Readout dates are coded at angermayer-0177. Affiliated (Compass investor).

event.asset: COMP360 (Compass Pathways' synthetic psilocybin): Phase 3 programme in treatment-resistant depression
event.title: A COMP360 (psilocybin) Phase 3 trial in treatment-resistant depression meets its primary endpoint
event.proposition: A Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression reports its prespecified primary endpoint met with statistical significance.

records.note: 'Likelihood of a successful phase three is very very high' reads as bin A. E-0074 is the class event and E-0058 the FDA action, so neither has this asset and outcome type. No date words; undated. Affiliated (Compass investor).

condition.asset: An atai Life Sciences psychedelic programme: Phase 3 clinical data
condition.title: An atai psychedelic programme reports positive Phase 3 clinical data
condition.proposition: atai Life Sciences (or a programme it owns or partners) reports Phase 3 clinical data for a psychedelic therapeutic with the prespecified primary endpoint met.

records.note: Conditional: if the Phase 3 data come, FDA approval is 'an automatism'. The FDA decides the approval, so not CONTROL. 'Will say ... we're going to approve' sets bin A. Undated. Affiliated (atai chairman).

event.asset: COMP360 (Compass Pathways' synthetic psilocybin): first Phase 3 topline readout
event.title: COMP360 (psilocybin) reports its first Phase 3 topline result
event.proposition: Compass Pathways reports the topline result, positive or negative, of the first Phase 3 trial of COMP360 (psilocybin).

records.note: Split -a: the psilocybin first Phase 3 readout. 'End of the year' = 31 December 2024 (year rule). 'Going to have' sets bin A. Affiliated (Compass investor).

Split -b: the 5-MeO-DMT readout maps to the BPL-003 Phase 2b topline (E-0020), the only 5-MeO-DMT readout in the registry. 'Mid of the year' = 30 June 2024. 'Going to have' sets bin A. Affiliated (atai).
'Practically the only major player' defines no countable set, share threshold or series, and 'it will be obvious' is not observable.

Denies take-home psychedelics: maps to approval with dispensing for use outside a healthcare setting (E-0067). 'Unrealistic' with asserts false and bin B gives p 0.3. 'In the next years' gives no N, so undated.
